items.title: 高盛稱中國半導體產能自給率達70% 先進製程仍受限於微影設備
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Says China's Semiconductor Capacity Self‑Supply Rate Reaches 70% but Advanced Nodes Still Hampered by Lithography Equipment
paras: 據美國投資銀行高盛發布的研究報告指出，截至2026年6月，中國半導體積體電路產量自給率已由2010年1月的38%大幅提升至70%。然而，受限於先進微影設備(光刻機)的出口管制，中國在短時間內仍難以實現半導體的完全自主供應。
報導指出，中國半導體產能的顯著增長，主要來自於成熟製程(22/28奈米及以上)的擴產，由中芯國際、華虹集團及晶合集成等晶圓代工廠提供汽車、工業及消費性電子所需晶片。截至2025年，中國大陸共擁有29座8吋晶圓廠與50座12吋晶圓廠，整體晶圓產能約占全球20%。
但在產能結構中，90至28奈米成熟製程占比達68.3%，110奈米及以上占30%，而14奈米及以下先進製程僅占1.7%。高單價與高毛利的先進SoC、CPU、GPU及高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，仍由台積電、三星、SK海力士等國際大廠主導。
在先進邏輯製程領域，據《南華早報》作者 Howard Liu 報導引述高盛預測，在人工智慧(AI)伺服器需求帶動下，2025至2035年間中國7奈米及以下晶圓需求複合年成長率(CAGR)為17%，而供給CAGR將達46%，預計可將供需缺口由2025年的92%縮小至2035年的34%。
不過，高盛模型預估，中芯國際先進製程製造良率在2026年僅約23%，至2035年提升至75%，相較台積電7奈米逾90%的良率水平仍有差距，將直接影響單位成本與有效產出。
高盛分析強調，先進微影設備(尤其是極紫外光微影 EUV)的短缺是限制中國晶片完全自主的核心瓶頸。在無法取得 EUV 的情況下，晶圓廠需依賴深紫外光微影(DUV)進行多重圖案化(多重曝光)技術，但這意味著製造步驟增加、生產成本上升及良率降低。
市場觀察人士指出，業界正嘗試透過先進封裝、混合鍵合與晶片堆疊等技術來補強效能差距，中國半導體產業因此正同步推進成熟製程自主化、DUV技術創新及EUV突破等多軌並進策略。
paras_en: According to a research report released by U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs, by June 2026 China’s semiconductor integrated circuit production self‑supply rate has risen sharply from 38% in January 2010 to 70%. However, due to export controls on advanced lithography equipment (photolithography machines), China is still unlikely to achieve fully autonomous semiconductor supply in the short term.

The report notes that the significant growth in China’s semiconductor capacity comes mainly from expansion of mature processes (22/28 nm and larger) provided by foundries such as SMIC, Huahong Group and JCET, which supply chips for automotive, industrial and consumer electronics. By the end of 2025 mainland China operates 29 eight‑inch wafer fabs and 50 twelve‑inch wafer fabs, together accounting for roughly 20% of global wafer capacity.

Within the capacity mix, mature processes from 90 nm to 28 nm represent 68.3% of output, 110 nm and above account for 30%, while advanced processes of 14 nm and below make up only 1.7%. High‑price, high‑margin advanced SoCs, CPUs, GPUs and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) remain dominated by international giants such as TSMC, Samsung and SK Hynix.

In the advanced logic segment, citing a Howard Liu article in the South China Morning Post that quotes Goldman Sachs, AI‑driven server demand is expected to drive a 17% compound annual growth rate (CAGR) for China’s 7‑nm and below wafer demand from 2025 to 2035, while supply CAGR could reach 46%, narrowing the supply‑demand gap from 92% in 2025 to 34% in 2035.

However, Goldman’s model estimates that SMIC’s advanced‑process yield will be only about 23% in 2026, improving to 75% by 2035, still well below TSMC’s over‑90% yield for 7 nm, which will directly affect unit costs and effective output.

Goldman’s analysis stresses that the shortage of advanced lithography equipment—especially extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV) tools—is the core bottleneck preventing China’s full chip autonomy. Without EUV, fabs must rely on deep‑ultraviolet (DUV) lithography with multiple patterning, which adds steps, raises production costs and reduces yields.

Market observers say the industry is trying to close the performance gap through advanced packaging, heterogeneous bonding and chip stacking, while China’s semiconductor sector pursues a multi‑track strategy that includes maturing mature‑process self‑sufficiency, DUV innovation and breakthroughs in EUV technology.

items.title: 166萬人小確幸！0056季配1.72元創新高 預估年化配息率12%

items.title: 和碩鄭光志：AI像空氣無所不在 分享內部AI落地四關鍵
items.title_en: Pegatron Co‑CEO Cheng Kuang‑chi: AI Is Like Air, Ubiquitous – Sharing Four Keys to Internal AI Implementation
paras: 和碩(4938-TW)今(1)日獲頒數位轉型鼎革獎「AI創新應用獎」製造業首獎，共同執行長鄭光志指出，AI發展至今，整個產業期待AI成為重要基礎設施，並形容「AI就像我們生活中呼吸的空氣、無時無刻要飲用的水源」，分享和碩內部落地AI的四大關鍵。
鄭光志表示，AI對於整個供應鏈而言，就像過去的電力一樣，對世界造成很大的變化。進到工業4.0後，再加上AI的應用與導入，認為變化會比過去100以來看到的成果更加驚人。
鄭光志進一步以Google(GOOG-US)為例，指出Google於美國時間9月30日發表全新AI模型Argon，並以Gemini 4世代為核心，不過在這之前，ChatGPT可能已經領先幾個月，但馬上又被Gemini翻盤，基礎模型迭代迅速。他並指出，AI近兩年成長的幅度，已遠超過人類文明過去數百年的累積。
鄭光志表示，以今年4月國際清算銀行(BIS)公布的數據，台灣20家大型AI企業創造的總市值，已是台灣GDP的2倍多，顯示台灣AI硬體在全球供應鏈中位居重要地位，不過除硬體價值，認為台灣產業還需深化AI使用與應用。
因此鄭光志分享和碩導入AI的4大關鍵，首先是規模化，利用大數據推動員工廣泛使用；第二，透過內部平台Pegaverse，讓各層級員工都可便捷使用；第三，數據治理與資安需有良好規範；第四則是需追上AI進化的速度，持續追趕最新科技與模型迭代。
paras_en: Pegatron (4938‑TW) was awarded today (the 1st) the Digital Transformation Innovation Award for "AI Innovative Application" – the top prize in manufacturing. Co‑CEO Cheng Kuang‑chi said that AI has matured to the point where the whole industry expects it to become a fundamental infrastructure, likening it to "the air we breathe and the water we constantly drink" and shared the four key factors for bringing AI to life inside Pegatron.

Cheng explained that AI is to the entire supply chain what electricity once was – a transformative force for the world. With Industry 4.0 already underway, the addition of AI applications and deployments will produce changes even more astonishing than any achievements seen in the past century.

He cited Google (GOOG‑US) as an example, noting that on September 30 (U.S. time) Google unveiled a new AI model called Argon, built around the Gemini 4 generation. Although ChatGPT may have been ahead by a few months, Gemini quickly turned the tables, illustrating how rapidly foundational models evolve. Cheng added that AI’s growth over the past two years has far outpaced the cumulative progress of human civilization over several hundred years.

Cheng pointed to data released in April by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS), showing that the combined market value of Taiwan’s 20 largest AI firms now exceeds twice Taiwan’s GDP, underscoring the critical role of Taiwan’s AI hardware in the global supply chain. Beyond hardware, he said Taiwan’s industries still need to deepen AI usage and applications.

Accordingly, Cheng outlined Pegatron’s four pillars for AI adoption: first, scaling – leveraging big data to drive widespread employee usage; second, an internal platform called Pegaverse that makes AI tools easily accessible to staff at all levels; third, robust data governance and cybersecurity standards; and fourth, keeping pace with AI’s rapid evolution by continuously chasing the latest technologies and model updates.

items.title: 債市大利多！債券及ETF免徵證交稅再延10年 主動式ETF也納入
items.title_en: Bond Market Boon! Tax Exemption on Bonds and ETFs Extended Another 10 Years, Active Bond ETFs Included
paras: 行政院今（1）日正式通過《證券交易稅條例》第2條之1修正草案，決定將公司債、金融債券及被動式債券ETF停徵證交稅期限延長10年至125年12月31日，同時首度將主動式債券ETF納入停徵範圍，預計將有效活絡台灣債券市場，提升資產管理業務動能，進一步實現「亞洲資產管理中心」政策目標。
行政院長卓榮泰表示，政府自99年起停徵公司債及金融債券之證券交易稅，並於106年將被動式債券ETF納入停徵範圍。該項政策實施至今成效相當良好，成功協助企業順利籌措資金，並深化資本市場發展。考量現行租稅優惠即將屆期，為延續市場熱度並維持政策穩定性，決定延長停徵期限10年。
卓榮泰進一步指出，本次修法不僅延長現有優惠，更配合金融市場發展趨勢，自116年1月1日起將主動式債券ETF受益憑證同步納入停徵證交稅範圍。此舉將能大幅提升整體資產管理業務動能，為資本市場注入全新資金活水，兼顧租稅公平並帶動整體稅收成長。
行政院會通過後，該修正草案將立即送請立法院審議。卓榮泰指示財政部會同金管會，積極與立法院朝野各黨團進行溝通協調，爭取早日完成修法程序，以利市場政策"無縫“對接，保障投資人權益。
本次《證券交易稅條例》修法重點包含三大層面：第一，延長公司債、金融債券及被動式債券ETF停徵證券交易稅10年至125年12月31日；第二，將主動式債券ETF受益憑證納入停徵範圍，停徵期間自116年1月1日至125年12月31日止；第三，刪除被動式債券ETF投資標的限制之相關規定，回歸由目的事業主管機關依權責控管，給予市場更具彈性的發展空間。
paras_en: The Executive Yuan formally approved the amendment draft to Article 2-1 of the Securities Transaction Tax Act today, deciding to extend the tax‑exempt period for corporate bonds, financial bonds and passive bond ETFs by ten years to December 31, 2125, and for the first time to include active bond ETFs in the exemption, a move expected to revitalize Taiwan’s bond market, boost asset‑management activity and further the “Asian Asset Management Hub” policy goal.

Premier Zhuo Rong‑tai said the government has exempted corporate and financial bonds from securities transaction tax since 2010 and added passive bond ETFs to the exemption in 2017. The policy has worked well, helping companies raise funds and deepening the capital market. With the current tax incentives about to expire, the government decided to extend the exemption by ten years to keep market momentum and policy stability.

Zhuo added that the amendment not only prolongs existing benefits but also, in line with market trends, will bring active bond ETF beneficiary certificates under the tax‑exempt regime starting Jan 1, 2027. This is expected to significantly boost overall asset‑management activity, inject fresh capital into the market, ensure tax fairness and drive overall tax revenue growth.

After the Executive Yuan’s approval, the amendment will be sent to the Legislative Yuan for consideration. Zhuo instructed the Ministry of Finance, together with the Financial Supervisory Commission, to actively coordinate with all legislative parties to expedite the amendment so that market policies can be “seamlessly” implemented and investors’ rights protected.

The key points of the Securities Transaction Tax amendment are threefold: 1) extend the tax‑exempt period for corporate bonds, financial bonds and passive bond ETFs by ten years to Dec 31, 2125; 2) include active bond ETF beneficiary certificates in the exemption from Jan 1, 2027 to Dec 31, 2125; and 3) delete the rules limiting the investment targets of passive bond ETFs, returning that authority to the relevant supervisory agencies to give the market more flexible development space.

items.title: 〈房產〉台北車站區商四土地釋出 預計11/16開標
items.title_en: Real Estate: Taipei Main Station Area Commercial Land Released, Bidding Expected on Nov 16
paras: 商仲業者第一太平戴維斯受託辦理台北車站精華商業土地公開標售，標的坐落於台北市中正區重慶南路一段，距離站前地下街Z10出入口僅300公尺，基地面積106.78坪，地上建物面積320.11坪，土地使用分區為第四種商業區，法定建蔽率及容積率分別為75%及800%，開標日為11月16日。
第一太平戴維斯指出，此一地產標售案具有產權單一、基地方正等優勢；而地產業者估計此一標售金額將逾10億元。

近年在危老重建政策推動及西區門戶計畫帶動下，台北車站商圈內具開發潛力的土地資產備受市場關注。根據內政部統計，台北市自2024年至今年8月累計核准危老案件達156件，主要集中於大安區、士林區及中正區等開發較早的區域。其中，北車商圈近三年已核准5件危老案，基地面積介於70- 400坪，集中在重慶南路一段及南陽街一帶。其中已有2件已取得建照，基地規模分別為72坪及152坪，目前均規劃為精品住宅產品，坪數約12-27坪、1至3房格局，預售成交單價約每坪140萬元。
台北車站商圈為台北市發展成熟的商業核心區，區內老舊建物比例較高，可開發土地稀缺，新案開發多仰賴危老重建機制推進。根據統計，2024-2026年間，北車商圈透天交易件數達12件，交易總金額為50億元，交易熱區主要集中於南陽街、信陽街及博愛路一帶。
而最新交易為今年6月博愛路一棟三層樓透天以8億元成交，土地面積約81坪，拆算土地單價約976萬元，由建商司取得。另外，也有資產公司陸續購入北車商圈7棟透天，計畫重建開發，總金額達11.9億元，合計取得土地面積約243坪，並將其中數棟透天申請危老重建，已於2026年8月申請建照，也反映開發商或資產公司持續關注北車開發機會。
第一太平戴維斯總經理陳逸鴻表示，隨著西區門戶計畫多項重大建設陸續到位，台北車站商圈正迎來新一波發展契機。預計於2027年完工的台北雙星C1棟、海悅國際商業大樓等指標開發案，將持續為北車商圈注入商業、辦公及觀光機能，不僅有助於提升整體商圈的動能，也可望帶動周邊商業活動與人流成長，進一步強化台北車站商圈作為首都門戶與核心商業區的地位，外溢效應亦可望帶動周邊都更及危老重建開發持續推進。
此一公開標售案坐落於北車商圈核心地段，臨20米重慶南路一段，基地面積106.78坪，地上透天建物面積320.11坪，土地使用分區為第四種商業區，法定容積率高達800%。此一標倍案產權單一且基地方整，百坪土地具備可立即開發條件，在北車地區相當稀有，未來可透過危老重建規劃精品住宅、商旅、及辦公空間等產品。
paras_en: First Taiwan-based brokerage Colliers International (First Tai Ping Davis) has been entrusted to handle a public auction of prime commercial land in the Taipei Main Station area. The parcel is located on Section 1 of Chongqing South Road in Zhongzheng District, only 300 meters from the Z10 entrance of the underground station mall. The site covers 106.78 ping of land with a building of 320.11 ping above ground. It is zoned as a Type‑4 commercial district, with statutory building coverage and floor‑area ratios of 75% and 800% respectively. The opening bid is scheduled for November 16.
Colliers notes that the sale benefits from a single ownership structure and a well‑located site, and estimates that the winning bid could exceed NT$1 billion.

In recent years, driven by the unsafe‑building renewal policy and the West District Gateway project, land assets with development potential in the Taipei Main Station commercial zone have attracted strong market interest. According to the Ministry of the Interior, Taipei City approved 156 unsafe‑building cases from 2024 through August of this year, mainly in the early‑development districts of Da’an, Shilin and Zhongzheng. Within the North Station area, five unsafe‑building cases have been approved over the past three years, on sites ranging from 70 to 400 ping, concentrated around Section 1 of Chongqing South Road and Nanyang Street. Two of these have already obtained building permits; the parcels are 72 ping and 152 ping and are being planned as boutique residential units of about 12‑27 ping, 1‑3 bedroom layouts, with pre‑sale prices around NT$1.4 million per ping.

The Taipei Main Station commercial zone is a mature core business district in the city, characterized by a high proportion of aging buildings and scarce developable land, making new projects heavily reliant on the unsafe‑building renewal mechanism. Statistics show that between 2024 and 2026, there were 12 townhouse transactions in the North Station area, totaling NT$5 billion, with hot spots centered on Nanyang Street, Xinyang Street and Bo’ai Road.

The latest transaction was a three‑story townhouse on Bo’ai Road sold in June for NT$800 million; the land area is about 81 ping, giving a land price of roughly NT$9.76 million per ping, acquired by developer Si. Additionally, an asset firm has been buying seven townhouses in the North Station area for redevelopment, spending a total of NT$1.19 billion for about 243 ping of land. Several of these properties have applied for unsafe‑building renewal permits, with building permits filed in August 2026, indicating continued interest from developers and asset managers in the North Station development opportunities.

Colliers General Manager Chen Yi‑hong said that with the rollout of several major projects under the West District Gateway plan, the Taipei Main Station commercial zone is entering a new wave of development. Flagship projects slated for completion in 2027, such as the Taipei Twin Stars C1 tower and the Haiyue International Commercial Building, will inject commercial, office and tourism functions into the area, boosting overall momentum, attracting more business activity and foot traffic, and reinforcing the station’s role as the capital’s gateway and core business district. The spill‑over effects are also expected to spur surrounding urban renewal and unsafe‑building redevelopment.

This public auction is located in the heart of the North Station zone, adjacent to the 20‑meter Section 1 of Chongqing South Road. The site covers 106.78 ping of land with a 320.11‑ping townhouse above ground, zoned as a Type‑4 commercial district with a floor‑area ratio of up to 800%. The parcel has a single ownership and a well‑aligned site; a hundred‑ping lot ready for immediate development is rare in the North Station area and could be used for boutique residential, hotel‑type, or office projects through unsafe‑building renewal planning.

items.title: 崇越深化日本布局 福岡營業所今正式啟用
items.title_en: Chongyue Deepens Japan Footprint as Fukuoka Office Officially Opens
paras: 半導體材料通路大廠崇越(5434-TW)持續加速海外市場布局，今(1)日宣布旗下日本子公司「峻川商事株式會社」於今日正式啟用福岡營業所，連同現有的東京總公司與熊本營業所，峻川商事在日布局第三個據點，藉由福岡得天獨厚的地理優勢與產業聚集效應，強化九州半導體重鎮的即時技術支援與新業務開拓動能。
福岡市作為九州第一大都會區與經濟樞紐，坐擁完善的海、陸、空交通網絡。崇越首席執行長陳德懿表示，過去崇越科技在九州以熊本為支點扎根在地服務；如今是一個好時機設立福岡營業所，藉由密集的航線與新幹線路網，往南可便捷通往長崎的影像感測器聚落、往北串聯廣島的先進記憶體重鎮，能更迅速應對新廠擴建商機與客戶需求，滿足晶圓代工新廠與IDM大廠在先進材料、設備與高階部品上的多樣化需求。
未來，崇越科技與峻川商事將持續評估日本據點擴展計畫，藉由供應鏈與價值鏈平台，將更多優質產品帶給客戶。
paras_en: Semiconductor materials distributor Chongyue (5434‑TW) continues to accelerate its overseas market expansion, announcing today that its Japanese subsidiary Junkawa Trading Co., Ltd. has officially opened a Fukuoka office. Together with its existing Tokyo headquarters and Kumamoto office, Junkawa now has a third location in Japan, leveraging Fukuoka’s unique geographic advantage and industry clustering to strengthen real‑time technical support and new‑business development in the semiconductor hub of Kyushu.

Fukuoka City, the largest metropolitan area and economic hub of Kyushu, boasts a comprehensive sea, land, and air transportation network. Chongyue CEO Chen De‑yi noted that the company has historically rooted its Kyushu operations in Kumamoto, but now is a good time to establish a Fukuoka office. With dense flight routes and Shinkansen lines, the location offers convenient southward access to the imaging‑sensor cluster in Nagasaki and northward linkage to Hiroshima’s advanced memory hub, enabling faster response to new plant expansion opportunities and customer needs, and meeting the diverse demands of wafer‑foundry new plants and IDM giants for advanced materials, equipment, and high‑end components.
Going forward, Chongyue and Junkawa will continue to evaluate plans to expand their Japanese sites, using supply‑chain and value‑chain platforms to bring more high‑quality products to customers.

items.title: 配息基金推薦前必看的6大風險! 月配息基金有哪些風險？
items.title_en: Six Major Risks to Check Before Recommending Dividend Funds! What Risks Do Monthly Dividend Funds Have?
paras: 從本金配息、含息總報酬到信用與匯率風險，建立月配息基金檢查方法
快速答案｜配息基金推薦不能只看年化配息率。挑選月配息基金時，至少要確認含息總報酬、近12期本金配息比例、三年波動度、配息金額是否穩定及經理費。高配息不代表高報酬；若淨值持續下跌，即使每月收到配息，整體投資仍可能虧損。
月配息基金能提供定期現金流，因此常受到退休族或希望增加被動收入者關注。但「每月收到配息」不等於「每月都有獲利」，真正賺賠仍須同時觀察配息與淨值變化。
月配息基金的6大風險是什麼？
為什麼領到8%配息，含息總報酬仍可能是-4%？
假設投入10萬元，一年收到8,000元配息，但年底基金市值降至88,000元，配息加市值合計只有96,000元。雖然現金配息率為8%，整體投資仍虧損4%。
配息基金推薦怎麼避開高息陷阱？
比起只看單一數字，更實用的方法是觀察幾個數字是否同時惡化。出現以下情況時，代表應進一步檢查，而不是立刻以高配息率做決定。
配息基金推薦案例：富蘭克林穩定月收益基金有哪些優勢與風險？
把前述檢查方式套用在公開資料案例。以富蘭克林坦伯頓全球投資系列－穩定月收益基金美元A（Mdis）股為例檢視（下稱富蘭克林穩定月收益基金），該基金同時配置股票與債券，投資政策以收益與資本利得並重，綜合各項指標表現均衡。
富蘭克林穩定月收益基金有哪些優勢？又要留意什麼？
相對優勢在於1、3、5及10年原幣含息總報酬表現長期可期；連續44期每單位配息維持0.067美元；一年波動度為4.61%，經理費為0.85%。因此，若投資人需要月現金流，又希望保留股票帶來的中長期成長機會，可將其納入配息基金推薦選項之一。
仍應留意哪些限制？
限制同樣不能忽略：近12期本金配息占比平均約42%，但這項數據不宜單獨解讀為基金好壞。基金配息可能來自利息、股利、選擇權權利金、已實現資本利得、累積收益或本金，較重要的是配息後的中長期含息總報酬與淨值是否維持穩健。此外，配息金額與配息率並非永久保證，可能調整。
月配息基金常見問題
配息基金推薦可以只看配息率嗎？
不建議。配息率適合估算現金流，但不等於投資報酬，仍須搭配含息總報酬、淨值及本金配息比例判斷。
配息來自本金，代表基金一定不好嗎？
不一定。單期本金配息可能受到收益認列影響，應觀察近12期平均；若本金比例持續偏高、淨值下跌且含息總報酬落後，才是較明確的警訊。
月配息基金適合退休族嗎？
視情況而定。月配息有助安排生活現金流，但仍應保留緊急預備金，避免市場下跌時因生活費需求被迫贖回。
結論：配息基金推薦，先確認風險再看配息率
月配息基金並非一定不好，對需要定期現金流的投資人可能具有實用性；但真正有用的配息基金推薦，應同時回答三件事：配息後是否維持含息總報酬、風險是否在可承受範圍，以及現金流是否符合實際需求。先看總報酬與資產價值，再比較配息率，較能避免只領到現金卻忽略本金縮水。想了解完整配息基金推薦方法，可進一步閱讀「配息基金推薦怎麼挑？6項指標破解高配息迷思」。
重要提醒｜基金配息不代表基金實際報酬，配息來源可能包含本金，且配息金額與配息率均不保證固定。基金淨值會波動，外幣級別另有匯率風險；投資前應詳閱公開說明書。
paras_en: From principal dividend, total return including dividends, to credit and currency risks, establish a checklist for monthly dividend funds.

Quick answer: You can't recommend dividend funds based solely on the annualized dividend yield. When selecting a monthly dividend fund, you must at least verify the total return including dividends, the principal dividend ratio over the latest 12 periods, three‑year volatility, whether the dividend amount is stable, and the management fee. A high dividend does not mean a high return; if the net asset value keeps falling, the overall investment may still lose money even though you receive monthly payouts.

Monthly dividend funds can provide regular cash flow, so they often attract retirees or those seeking additional passive income. But “receiving a dividend each month” does not equal “making a profit each month”; true profit or loss still requires looking at both the dividend and the NAV changes.
What are the six major risks of monthly dividend funds?
Why can a fund that pays an 8% dividend still have a total return of –4%?

Assume you invest NT$100,000 and receive NT$8,000 in dividends over the year, but the fund’s market value drops to NT$88,000 at year‑end. The combined dividend and market value total only NT$96,000. Although the cash dividend yield is 8%, the overall investment still loses 4%.
How to avoid high‑yield traps when recommending dividend funds?

Instead of looking at a single figure, a more practical approach is to watch several numbers for simultaneous deterioration. When the following conditions appear, you should conduct a deeper check rather than decide immediately based on a high dividend yield.
Recommendation case: What are the advantages and risks of the Franklin Stable Monthly Income Fund?

Apply the above checklist to a publicly available example. Using the Franklin Templeton Global Investment Series – Stable Monthly Income Fund USD A (Mdis) as an illustration (hereafter the Franklin Stable Monthly Income Fund), the fund allocates both equities and bonds, with an investment policy that balances income and capital gains, resulting in a well‑rounded performance across all indicators.
What are the advantages of the Franklin Stable Monthly Income Fund? What should investors watch out for?

Its relative strengths are the long‑term performance of total return including dividends over 1, 3, 5 and 10 years in the fund’s base currency; a consistent per‑unit dividend of $0.067 for 44 consecutive periods; a one‑year volatility of 4.61%; and a management fee of 0.85%. Therefore, if an investor needs monthly cash flow while still wanting the medium‑ to long‑term growth potential of equities, this fund can be considered one of the recommended dividend‑fund options.
What limitations should still be noted?

Limitations must not be ignored either: the average principal‑dividend proportion over the latest 12 periods is about 42%, but this figure alone should not be interpreted as a quality indicator. Dividends may come from interest, dividends, option premiums, realized capital gains, accumulated earnings, or even principal. What matters more is whether the total return including dividends and the NAV remain stable in the medium to long term after the payout. Moreover, dividend amounts and yields are not permanently guaranteed and may be adjusted.
Common questions about monthly dividend funds
Can I recommend a dividend fund based only on its dividend yield?

Not recommended. The dividend yield is useful for estimating cash flow, but it does not equal investment return; you still need to consider total return including dividends, NAV, and the principal‑dividend ratio.
If dividends come from principal, does that mean the fund is necessarily bad?

Not necessarily. A single period’s principal dividend may be affected by earnings recognition, so you should look at the average over the latest 12 periods. Only when the principal proportion stays high, NAV declines, and total return lags does it become a clear warning sign.
Are monthly dividend funds suitable for retirees?
It depends. Monthly dividends help plan living cash flow, but investors should still keep an emergency reserve to avoid forced redemptions when markets fall.
Conclusion: When recommending dividend funds, first confirm the risks before looking at the dividend yield.

Monthly dividend funds are not inherently bad and can be practical for investors who need regular cash flow; however, a truly useful recommendation should answer three questions: does the fund maintain total return after the payout, are the risks within an acceptable range, and does the cash flow meet actual needs? Look at total return and asset value first, then compare the dividend yield, which better prevents receiving cash while ignoring principal erosion. For a complete recommendation method, read “How to Choose Dividend Funds? Six Indicators to Decode High‑Yield Myths.”

Important reminder: A fund’s dividend does not represent its actual return; dividend sources may include principal, and both the dividend amount and yield are not guaranteed to stay fixed. NAV fluctuates, and foreign‑currency funds carry additional exchange‑rate risk. Investors should read the prospectus carefully before investing.

items.title: 擔心意外拉抬汽油價格 川普對美國柴油出口禁令態度轉趨審慎
items.title_en: Trump Becomes More Cautious on U.S. Diesel Export Ban Over Fears It Could Spike Gasoline Prices
paras: 美國總統川普近期對禁止美國柴油出口的態度明顯冷卻，主因在於相關限制恐引發其他燃料價格意外飆升的風險。
隨著美國期中選舉臨近，零售柴油價格達到每加侖 6.41 美元，逼近歷史高點，高昂的生活成本使白宮承受沉重的選民壓力。
為抑制物價，當局先前曾研議禁止柴油外銷，但石油高層與能源分析師警告，煉油廠在煉製柴油時會同時產出汽油與航空燃油，若限制柴油出口導致煉油廠減產，汽油供應將同步減少，進而推升汽油零售價格。
面對各界擔憂，川普周三(30日)坦言，他正與能源部長賴特(Chris Wright)及內政部長柏根(Doug Burgum)商討出口限制，但也承認廣泛禁令可能帶來副作用。
川普表示：「他們認為這有助於降低柴油價格，但可能拉高其他產品的價格。這似乎會對汽油產生負面影響，導致汽油微幅上漲、柴油小幅下跌。」
柏根接受Fox Business採訪時指出：「川普總統正在評估所有可能降低物價的想法，但正如他所承認的，當煉油製程同時產出柴油、航空燃油與汽油時，限制供應最終恐導致其他產品價格上漲。」
在出口禁令疑慮緩解之際，白宮轉向研議其他降溫措施。能源部長賴特透露，歐洲盟友近期可能宣布向市場釋出新的柴油供應。賴特同時指出，部分歐洲國家在協調釋放石油儲備方面進度落後，僅釋出承諾的一小部分。
內政部長柏根透露，歐洲在維持成品油戰略儲備方面表現出色，若自願釋放儲備，將能協助拉低全球油價。
隨著白宮轉向研議免徵柴油消費稅或協調盟國釋備等方案，市場恐慌逐步平息。能源諮詢機構瑞皮丹能源集團(Rapidan Energy Group)隨即將美國實施嚴格出口限制的機率從 75% 大幅下調至 40%。
paras_en: President Trump’s recent stance on banning U.S. diesel exports has noticeably cooled, mainly because the restriction could unexpectedly drive up prices of other fuels.
With the midterm elections looming, retail diesel has risen to $6.41 per gallon, near historic highs, and the high cost of living is putting heavy pressure on the White House from voters.

To curb inflation, officials had previously considered prohibiting diesel exports, but oil executives and energy analysts warned that refineries produce gasoline and jet fuel alongside diesel, so limiting diesel shipments could force plants to cut output and reduce gasoline supply, pushing retail gasoline prices higher.

Facing concerns from all sides, Trump told reporters on Wednesday the 30th that he is discussing export limits with Energy Secretary Chris Wright and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum, while acknowledging that a broad ban could have side effects.

Trump said, “They think it will help lower diesel prices, but it could lift the price of other products. It seems likely to hurt gasoline, causing a slight rise in gasoline and a modest drop in diesel.”

Burgum told Fox Business, “The president is weighing every idea that could bring down prices, but as he admits, when refining produces diesel, jet fuel and gasoline together, restricting supply could ultimately raise the price of other products.”

As worries over an export ban ease, the White House is looking at other cooling measures. Energy Secretary Wright said European allies may soon announce new diesel supplies to the market, and noted that some European countries are lagging in coordinating the release of oil reserves, having released only a small fraction of what they pledged.
Interior Secretary Burgum added that Europe has performed well in maintaining strategic stocks of refined fuels, and that voluntary releases of those reserves could help pull down global oil prices.

With the White House shifting to consider measures such as waiving diesel consumption taxes or coordinating reserve releases with allies, market panic is gradually subsiding. Rapidan Energy Group promptly cut the probability of the U.S. imposing a strict export ban from 75% to 40%.

items.title: 富邦金暨子公司投入AI智慧服務與治理 獲國內外大獎肯定
items.title_en: Fubon Financial and Subsidiaries Earn Domestic and International Awards for AI Smart Services and Governance
paras: 富邦金控暨子公司持續深化數位轉型與人工智慧應用，近期接連獲得國內外專業獎項肯定。《哈佛商業評論》2026數位轉型鼎革獎公布獲獎名單，富邦證券榮獲「AI創新應用獎-楷模獎」，台北富邦銀行也獲得「智慧管理轉型獎-績優獎」肯定。此外，富邦金控憑藉集團級可信任AI治理框架及創新RegTech技術應用，榮獲國際機構Asian Banking & Finance Fintech Awards 2026「台灣最佳監理科技創新獎(RegTech Initiative Award – Taiwan)」，彰顯富邦運用科技驅動創新、打造智慧金融生態圈的亮眼成果。

富邦證券推出「富邦AI PRO」 以AI創新升級投資體驗 

富邦證券以「富邦AI PRO」創新專案，榮獲 2026《哈佛商業評論》「AI創新應用獎」服務業大型企業組楷模獎肯定。「富邦AI PRO」結合投資人資訊理解與決策需求，將交易工具升級為智慧決策平台，並整合AI分析師、AI投資助理、法說會摘要等功能，協助投資人完成從資訊理解、投資分析到交易執行，提升投資決策效率。
此外，富邦證券將AI納入公司治理架構，設置人工智慧治理委員會，並建立涵蓋風險控管、系統生命週期及資訊安全的管理機制，在推動創新應用的同時兼顧安全性與可信度。未來，富邦證券將持續深化AI應用，拓展多元投資場景，提供更智慧、個人化且值得信賴的投資服務。

北富銀運用AI與大數據 打造智慧風控新典範

台北富邦銀行以「制度化即時市場風險治理之智慧管理轉型專案」榮獲2026數位轉型鼎革獎智慧管理組肯定。北富銀歷時七年推動市場風險管理轉型，整合自主評價模型、大數據分析及AI智慧監控技術，建立即時且制度化的風險治理架構，將傳統事後查核模式升級為主動預警與即時管理，以科技實力打造更快速、更精準、更透明的金融服務，為企業及法人客戶提供更值得信賴的交易體驗。
對企業客戶而言，風險管理不只是銀行內部的管理機制，更是支持客戶穩健經營與掌握市場先機的重要基礎。北富銀持續將AI與科技能力融入金融服務，從「管理風險」進一步走向「創造服務價值」，以更敏捷的服務速度、更透明的交易資訊及更專業的金融解決方案，陪伴企業客戶因應市場變化，提升資金運用效率與風險管理能力。

富邦金控創新RegTech技術強化金融AI風險管理

富邦金控持續深化人工智慧（AI）應用與治理發展，建構集團級可信任AI治理框架，整合AI治理、模型管理與安全防護機制，打造兼顧創新、效率與安全的AI應用環境，獲得ABF Fintech Awards 2026「台灣最佳監理科技創新獎(RegTech Initiative Award – Taiwan)」。面對生成式AI帶來的模型風險、個資保護及治理挑戰，富邦率先建立涵蓋AI全生命週期的治理模式，以制度治理結合創新RegTech技術，落實負責任AI發展，以金融業運用人工智慧(AI)之六大核心原則為基礎，建立73項監控指標，建立從模型開發、部署到持續監控的完整管理機制，強化AI應用的可控性、透明性與可追溯性。

富邦金控同時導入AI Security DevOps、B-REAL大型語言模型微調框架及Hybrid Guardrail智能護欄三大RegTech創新技術。其中，B-REAL透過行為導向強化學習優化模型決策品質，成功降低65.5%幻覺率，並提升21%回覆品質，強化生成式AI於金融場景的可靠性；Hybrid Guardrail則防範個資外洩、提示詞攻擊及不當內容風險等，加強資料安全防護機制。未來富邦金控將持續深化AI治理與創新應用，打造值得信賴的智慧金融生態圈。
paras_en: Fubon Financial Holding and its subsidiaries continue to deepen digital transformation and AI applications, recently receiving recognition from both domestic and overseas professional awards. The Harvard Business Review 2026 Digital Transformation Innovation Awards announced the winners, with Fubon Securities receiving the "AI Innovation Application Award – Model Award" and Taipei Fubon Bank earning the "Smart Management Transformation Award – Excellence Award." Additionally, Fubon Financial Holding was honored by the Asian Banking & Finance Fintech Awards 2026 with the "Taiwan Best RegTech Innovation Award (RegTech Initiative Award – Taiwan)" for its group‑level trustworthy AI governance framework and innovative RegTech technology applications, highlighting its achievements in leveraging technology to drive innovation and build a smart financial ecosystem.

Fubon Securities launched the "Fubon AI PRO" project, earning the 2026 Harvard Business Review "AI Innovation Application Award" in the large‑enterprise services category for its model award. "Fubon AI PRO" integrates investor information comprehension and decision‑making needs, upgrading trading tools into an intelligent decision‑making platform and incorporating AI analysts, AI investment assistants, earnings‑call summaries, and other features to help investors move from information understanding through analysis to trade execution, enhancing investment decision efficiency.

Furthermore, Fubon Securities has incorporated AI into its corporate governance structure by establishing an Artificial Intelligence Governance Committee and creating management mechanisms covering risk control, system lifecycle, and information security, ensuring safety and trustworthiness while promoting innovative applications. Going forward, the firm will continue to deepen AI usage, expand into diverse investment scenarios, and provide smarter, more personalized, and reliable investment services.

Taipei Fubon Bank used AI and big data to create a new paradigm for smart risk control. The bank’s "Institutionalized Real‑Time Market Risk Governance Smart Management Transformation Project" won recognition in the smart management category of the 2026 Digital Transformation Innovation Awards. Over seven years, the bank transformed market‑risk management by integrating proprietary evaluation models, big‑data analytics, and AI‑driven monitoring, establishing an instant, institutionalized risk‑governance framework that upgrades traditional post‑event audits to proactive alerts and real‑time management, delivering faster, more precise, and transparent financial services and a more trustworthy trading experience for corporate and institutional clients.

For corporate clients, risk management is not only an internal banking mechanism but also a crucial foundation for supporting stable operations and seizing market opportunities. Taipei Fubon Bank continues to embed AI and technology capabilities into its financial services, moving from "risk management" to "creating service value," offering more agile service speed, transparent transaction information, and professional financial solutions to help corporate clients adapt to market changes, improve capital utilization efficiency, and enhance risk‑management capabilities.

Fubon Financial Holding continues to deepen AI applications and governance, building a group‑level trustworthy AI governance framework that integrates AI governance, model management, and security safeguards, creating an AI environment that balances innovation, efficiency, and safety, and earning the ABF Fintech Awards 2026 "Taiwan Best RegTech Innovation Award (RegTech Initiative Award – Taiwan)". Confronting model risks, personal data protection, and governance challenges posed by generative AI, Fubon pioneered a governance model covering the entire AI lifecycle, combining institutional governance with innovative RegTech techniques to implement responsible AI development. Based on six core principles for AI use in finance, it established 73 monitoring indicators and a complete management mechanism from model development and deployment to continuous monitoring, strengthening controllability, transparency, and traceability of AI applications.

Fubon Financial Holding also introduced three RegTech innovations: AI Security DevOps, the B‑REAL large‑language‑model fine‑tuning framework, and the Hybrid Guardrail intelligent safeguard. B‑REAL uses behavior‑driven reinforcement learning to improve model decision quality, reducing hallucination rates by 65.5% and boosting response quality by 21%, enhancing the reliability of generative AI in financial contexts; Hybrid Guardrail prevents personal data leaks, prompt‑injection attacks, and inappropriate content risks, bolstering data‑security defenses. The company will keep advancing AI governance and innovative applications to build a trustworthy smart‑finance ecosystem.

items.title_en: 166万股东的“小确幸”！0056季配1.72元创历史新高 预估年化配息率12%
paras: 166萬股東注意！元大高股息(0056-TW)今(1)日公告2026年第四季預估配息金額，每受益權單位預估配發新台幣 1.72 元，較上季的 1.35 元大幅調升，並創下掛牌以來新高。0056 今天收盤價為 56.85 元，若以第四季單季預估發放的 1.72 元進行單季年化推算(1.72 元 × 4 次 = 6.88 元)，預估年化配息率高達 12.1%，展現極強的現金流動能與配息調升力道。本次除息日定於 10 月 22 日，想參與配息的投資人最晚須在 10 月 21 日前買進並持有，配息發放日為 11 月 11 日。
不過，若加計 2026 年第一季實際配出 0.866 元、第二季 1 元、第三季 1.35 元及第四季預估 1.72 元，2026 全年累積配息金額高達 4.936 元，因此，年化配息率為 8.68%，較能真實反映全年穩健的填息與收益實力。元大投信預計於 10 月 20 日進行第二階段公告以確定最終配息金額。
台股近年受惠 AI 需求強勁成長，帶動上市櫃企業獲利與股價雙雙向上。據證交所資料，0056 於 9 月 18 日規模已正式突破 8,000 億元大關，成為市場首檔達成此里程碑的高股息 ETF。此外，根據投信投顧公會 8 月底統計，0056 的定期定額戶數與扣款金額分別來到 33.8 萬戶與 24 億元，雙雙續創歷史新高，顯示投資人對其長期高度認同。
元大高股息 ETF 研究團隊指出，目前台股結構良好，電子與金融類股皆因 AI 趨勢展現強勁動能。0056 採用「未來一年預測現金股利殖利率」選股策略，精選兼具獲利成長與配息能力的標的。截至 8 月底，半導體與電腦周邊設備合計占比 41.2%，金融保險類股則占 25.7%，充分受惠於資本市場熱絡與企業獲利增長，持續挹注成長型選股優勢。
據理柏資訊統計至 9 月底，0056 今年以來含息報酬率高達 66.5%，大幅超越高股息 ETF 平均的 52.9%；拉長時間至近 1 年、2 年、3 年，績效表現亦皆優於同類型平均水準。
元大投信特別提醒投資人，參加 ETF 配息時須留意「配息率不代表報酬率」。ETF 所領取到的企業股利已反映於每日淨值中，無論是否配出皆屬於投資人權益，除息時會將除息金額自淨值扣除，投資人宜一併留意淨值之變動。此外，不宜僅憑單次配息金額推估該 ETF 未來配息表現，建議以長期配息記錄作為參考標準，方能更有效評估長期配息能力與收益品質。

items.title: 牧德(3563)法說釋出強訊號，訂單排到明年下半年！產能一口氣擴至100億元，2027年毛利率拚回60%以上
items.title_en: Motech (3563) Sends Strong Signal in Legal Disclosure, Orders Booked Through Mid‑2027! Capacity Expanded to NT$10 billion, Gross Margin Targeted Above 60% by 2027
paras: AOI檢測設備廠牧德(3563-TW)昨(30)日召開法人說明會，公司表示，目前訂單能見度已由過去約3至5個月拉長至接近一年，現階段新增訂單多數須排至2027年下半年交貨，部分載板專案的能見度甚至長達3年。
訂單拉長也迫使牧德(3563-TW)重新調整擴產規畫，公司今年3月原先預計於年底前建立60億元營收規模的產能，但隨AI、半導體及載板需求持續增加，現有規畫已不足以支應訂單，因此將年底產能目標提高至100億元，後續還可進一步擴充至130億元。
牧德(3563-TW)8月營收3.61億元，年增35.67%；累計前8月營收26.32億元，累計年增14.39%。公司表示，目前已連續24個月營收年增、連續10個月月增，並連續6個月改寫單月營收新高。
不過，擴產並不代表所有新產品都能立即放量，電測機因配合FOPLP應用提高定位精度，驗證時程約延後一個月，顯示後續成長除了產能，仍取決於新設備的客戶認證與量產進度。

AI營收占比由70%提高至最高90%
牧德(3563-TW)目前採取「雙軌四線」策略，兩大市場分別為PCB與半導體封裝，四條產品線則涵蓋PCB AOI、PCB電測機、Wafer-level AOI及Packaged IC AOI。
PCB AOI目前已有13項產品銷售，另有5項產品開發中，預計明年產品數量增至18項。半導體方面已有3項產品上市，但目前僅1項明顯貢獻營收，另外2項雖已通過驗證，仍處於逐步導入階段。
公司預估，2026年約70%營收來自AI相關產品；隨半導體、載板、FOPLP及光模組設備陸續放量，2027年AI營收占比可望提高至80%至90%。
其中，2027年成長力道最強的業務預計是半導體與載板，其次為FOPLP與光模組；已於前期開始貢獻的GPU及AI伺服器相關PCB設備，則以溫和成長為主。相對而言，消費性產品過去占營收約10%至15%，公司將逐步降低承接比重，把有限產能優先配置至高單價、高附加價值產品。

FOPLP設備明年首季測試，電測機延後約一個月
公司預計於今年第四季末，將Packaged IC六面檢設備送至客戶端進行Beta Site測試；FOPLP設備則規畫於2027年第一季送交測試，可應用於5微米/5微米以下的高階載板，以及30×30與60×60規格的面板級封裝。
電測機原本被公司視為下一項重要成長產品，但為了配合FOPLP更高的探針定位精度，公司重新調整取放及定位系統，研發進度因此延後約一個月，目前已重新送交客戶驗證。
這也代表牧德(3563-TW)雖已提前準備產能，但新產品仍須依序完成驗證、試產與客戶擴產，營收貢獻不會在單一季度一次跳升。公司也指出，設備推出後通常要經過首次採購及認證，待客戶下一輪擴廠才可能擴大採購，成功產品從初期導入到高速成長，最快仍需要兩至三年。

產能衝上100億元，供應鏈反而成為主要風險
為支應未來訂單，牧德(3563-TW)將搬遷竹科部分業務、客服及倉儲單位，騰出既有空間作為研發與生產使用，昆山新廠也預計年底完成。整體產能預計由原定60億元提高至100億元，並保留擴充至130億元的空間，以支應2027年至2028年的需求。
然而，產能擴張目前最大的限制不只在廠房，而是關鍵零組件供應。公司表示，部分使用的Memory價格約上漲10倍、相機價格上漲逾2倍，部分零組件交期也由兩至三個月延長至半年以上。
牧德(3563-TW)因此將長交期物料的備貨量提高至交期的1.5倍，例如交期為6個月的零件，將預備約9個月需求，同時擴大兩岸機加工供應鏈，以降低缺料對交貨的影響。但提前備料也會推升庫存與營運資金需求，若產品驗證或客戶擴產延後，仍須留意庫存調整風險。
公司預期，隨高階半導體及載板產品占比提高、消費性低價訂單下降，2027年產品組合將優於2026年，毛利率可望維持或回到60%以上。
因此，牧德(3563-TW)這次法說釋出的訊號，不只是AI訂單增加，而是公司已為訂單能見度拉長重新調高產能上限。

paras_en: Motech (3563‑TW), a maker of AOI inspection equipment, held a corporate briefing yesterday (30th). The company said that order visibility has lengthened from the previous three‑to‑five‑month horizon to almost a year, and most new orders now have to be scheduled for delivery in the second half of 2027. Visibility for some substrate projects extends up to three years.

The longer order lead time forced Motech to revise its capacity‑expansion plan. In March the company had aimed to reach NT$6 billion of revenue‑generating capacity by year‑end, but continued growth in AI, semiconductor and substrate demand means the original plan is insufficient. The year‑end capacity target has therefore been raised to NT$10 billion, with the possibility of further expansion to NT$13 billion.

Motech posted August revenue of NT$361 million, up 35.67% year‑on‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months was NT$2.632 billion, a 14.39% year‑on‑year increase. The company noted that it has recorded 24 consecutive months of year‑over‑year revenue growth, 10 straight months of month‑over‑month growth, and six months of new single‑month revenue records.

However, capacity growth does not mean every new product can be mass‑produced immediately. The electrical test machine, which is being adapted for FOPLP applications to improve probe positioning accuracy, has its validation schedule delayed by about one month, indicating that future growth will also depend on customer qualification and ramp‑up of new equipment.

AI‑related revenue share has risen from 70% to as high as 90%. Motech currently follows a “dual‑track, four‑line” strategy, with two main markets—PCBs and semiconductor packaging—and four product lines covering PCB AOI, PCB electrical test machines, wafer‑level AOI and packaged‑IC AOI.

The PCB AOI line already offers 13 products, with five more under development, and the company expects to have 18 products by next year. In the semiconductor segment, three products are on the market, but only one currently contributes significantly to revenue; the other two have passed verification and are being introduced gradually.

The company estimates that about 70% of 2026 revenue will come from AI‑related products. As semiconductor, substrate, FOPLP and optical‑module equipment scale up, AI revenue could rise to 80‑90% of total revenue by 2027.

The strongest growth in 2027 is expected from semiconductor and substrate businesses, followed by FOPLP and optical‑module equipment. GPU and AI‑server‑related PCB equipment, which have already begun contributing, are projected to grow modestly. By contrast, consumer products, which have historically accounted for 10‑15% of revenue, will be gradually reduced in share as the company allocates limited capacity to high‑price, high‑value‑add products.

The FOPLP equipment is slated for testing in the first quarter of next year, while the packaged‑IC six‑side inspection system will be sent to customers for beta‑site testing at the end of this fourth quarter. The FOPLP system is designed for high‑end substrates below 5 µm × 5 µm and for panel‑level packages of 30 × 30 and 60 × 60 specifications.

The electrical test machine was originally seen as the next major growth product, but to meet the higher probe‑positioning precision required by FOPLP, the company re‑engineered its pick‑and‑place and positioning system, pushing the development timeline back by about a month. The revised unit has now been resubmitted for customer verification.

This means that although Motech has prepared capacity in advance, new products must still go through verification, pilot production and customer scale‑up sequentially, so revenue contributions will not jump in a single quarter. The company also notes that after equipment launch, an initial purchase and certification are required, and only after the customer’s next plant expansion will larger orders follow. From initial introduction to rapid growth, successful products typically need two to three years.

To meet future orders, Motech will relocate part of its Hsinchu Science Park operations, customer service and warehousing to free up existing space for R&D and production, and its new Kunshan plant is expected to be completed by year‑end. Overall capacity is being raised from the originally planned NT$6 billion to NT$10 billion, with room to expand further to NT$13 billion to serve demand through 2027‑2028.

However, the biggest constraint on capacity expansion is not the factory itself but the supply of critical components. The company said that prices for some memory parts have risen roughly ten‑fold, camera prices have more than doubled, and lead times for certain components have stretched from two‑to‑three months to over six months.

Motech therefore increased its safety stock for long‑lead‑time items to 1.5 times the lead time—e.g., for a part with a six‑month lead time, it will stock enough for about nine months of demand—and is expanding its cross‑strait machining supply chain to mitigate material shortages. Yet pre‑stocking raises inventory and working‑capital needs, and if product verification or customer scale‑up is delayed, inventory adjustments will be required.

The company expects that as high‑end semiconductor and substrate products take a larger share and low‑price consumer orders decline, the 2027 product mix will be better than 2026’s, allowing gross margins to stay at or return to above 60%.
Thus, the signal Motech conveyed in this legal disclosure is not only an increase in AI orders but also a deliberate raise of its capacity ceiling in response to longer order visibility.

items.title: 和碩鄭光志：AI像空氣無所不在 分享內部AI落地四關鍵
items.title_en: Pegatron Co‑CEO Cheng Kuang‑chi: AI Is Like Air, Ubiquitous – Sharing Four Keys to Internal AI Implementation
paras: 和碩(4938-TW)今(1)日獲頒數位轉型鼎革獎「AI創新應用獎」製造業首獎，共同執行長鄭光志指出，AI發展至今，整個產業期待AI成為重要基礎設施，並形容「AI就像我們生活中呼吸的空氣、無時無刻要飲用的水源」，分享和碩內部落地AI的四大關鍵。
鄭光志表示，AI對於整個供應鏈而言，就像過去的電力一樣，對世界造成很大的變化。進到工業4.0後，再加上AI的應用與導入，認為變化會比過去100以來看到的成果更加驚人。
鄭光志進一步以Google(GOOG-US)為例，指出Google於美國時間9月30日發表全新AI模型Argon，並以Gemini 4世代為核心，不過在這之前，ChatGPT可能已經領先幾個月，但馬上又被Gemini翻盤，基礎模型迭代迅速。他並指出，AI近兩年成長的幅度，已遠超過人類文明過去數百年的累積。
鄭光志表示，以今年4月國際清算銀行(BIS)公布的數據，台灣20家大型AI企業創造的總市值，已是台灣GDP的2倍多，顯示台灣AI硬體在全球供應鏈中位居重要地位，不過除硬體價值，認為台灣產業還需深化AI使用與應用。
因此鄭光志分享和碩導入AI的4大關鍵，首先是規模化，利用大數據推動員工廣泛使用；第二，透過內部平台Pegaverse，讓各層級員工都可便捷使用；第三，數據治理與資安需有良好規範；第四則是需追上AI進化的速度，持續追趕最新科技與模型迭代。
paras_en: Pegatron (4938‑TW) was awarded today (the 1st) the Digital Transformation Innovation Award for "AI Innovative Application" – the top prize in manufacturing. Co‑CEO Cheng Kuang‑chi said that AI has matured to the point where the whole industry expects it to become a fundamental infrastructure, likening it to "the air we breathe and the water we constantly drink" and shared the four key factors for bringing AI to life inside Pegatron.

Cheng explained that AI is to the entire supply chain what electricity once was – a transformative force for the world. With Industry 4.0 already underway, the addition of AI applications and deployments will produce changes even more astonishing than any achievements seen in the past century.

He cited Google (GOOG‑US) as an example, noting that on September 30 (U.S. time) Google unveiled a new AI model called Argon, built around the Gemini 4 generation. Although ChatGPT may have been ahead by a few months, Gemini quickly turned the tables, illustrating how rapidly foundational models evolve. Cheng added that AI’s growth over the past two years has far outpaced the cumulative progress of human civilization over several hundred years.

Cheng pointed to data released in April by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS), showing that the combined market value of Taiwan’s 20 largest AI firms now exceeds twice Taiwan’s GDP, underscoring the critical role of Taiwan’s AI hardware in the global supply chain. Beyond hardware, he said Taiwan’s industries still need to deepen AI usage and applications.

Accordingly, Cheng outlined Pegatron’s four pillars for AI adoption: first, scaling – leveraging big data to drive widespread employee usage; second, an internal platform called Pegaverse that makes AI tools easily accessible to staff at all levels; third, robust data governance and cybersecurity standards; and fourth, keeping pace with AI’s rapid evolution by continuously chasing the latest technologies and model updates.

items.title: 債市大利多！債券及ETF免徵證交稅再延10年 主動式ETF也納入
items.title_en: Bond Market Boon! Tax Exemption on Bonds and ETFs Extended Another 10 Years, Active Bond ETFs Included
paras: 行政院今（1）日正式通過《證券交易稅條例》第2條之1修正草案，決定將公司債、金融債券及被動式債券ETF停徵證交稅期限延長10年至125年12月31日，同時首度將主動式債券ETF納入停徵範圍，預計將有效活絡台灣債券市場，提升資產管理業務動能，進一步實現「亞洲資產管理中心」政策目標。
行政院長卓榮泰表示，政府自99年起停徵公司債及金融債券之證券交易稅，並於106年將被動式債券ETF納入停徵範圍。該項政策實施至今成效相當良好，成功協助企業順利籌措資金，並深化資本市場發展。考量現行租稅優惠即將屆期，為延續市場熱度並維持政策穩定性，決定延長停徵期限10年。
卓榮泰進一步指出，本次修法不僅延長現有優惠，更配合金融市場發展趨勢，自116年1月1日起將主動式債券ETF受益憑證同步納入停徵證交稅範圍。此舉將能大幅提升整體資產管理業務動能，為資本市場注入全新資金活水，兼顧租稅公平並帶動整體稅收成長。
行政院會通過後，該修正草案將立即送請立法院審議。卓榮泰指示財政部會同金管會，積極與立法院朝野各黨團進行溝通協調，爭取早日完成修法程序，以利市場政策"無縫“對接，保障投資人權益。
本次《證券交易稅條例》修法重點包含三大層面：第一，延長公司債、金融債券及被動式債券ETF停徵證券交易稅10年至125年12月31日；第二，將主動式債券ETF受益憑證納入停徵範圍，停徵期間自116年1月1日至125年12月31日止；第三，刪除被動式債券ETF投資標的限制之相關規定，回歸由目的事業主管機關依權責控管，給予市場更具彈性的發展空間。
paras_en: The Executive Yuan formally approved the amendment draft to Article 2-1 of the Securities Transaction Tax Act today, deciding to extend the tax‑exempt period for corporate bonds, financial bonds and passive bond ETFs by ten years to December 31, 2125, and for the first time to include active bond ETFs in the exemption, a move expected to revitalize Taiwan’s bond market, boost asset‑management activity and further the “Asian Asset Management Hub” policy goal.

Premier Zhuo Rong‑tai said the government has exempted corporate and financial bonds from securities transaction tax since 2010 and added passive bond ETFs to the exemption in 2017. The policy has worked well, helping companies raise funds and deepening the capital market. With the current tax incentives about to expire, the government decided to extend the exemption by ten years to keep market momentum and policy stability.

Zhuo added that the amendment not only prolongs existing benefits but also, in line with market trends, will bring active bond ETF beneficiary certificates under the tax‑exempt regime starting Jan 1, 2027. This is expected to significantly boost overall asset‑management activity, inject fresh capital into the market, ensure tax fairness and drive overall tax revenue growth.

After the Executive Yuan’s approval, the amendment will be sent to the Legislative Yuan for consideration. Zhuo instructed the Ministry of Finance, together with the Financial Supervisory Commission, to actively coordinate with all legislative parties to expedite the amendment so that market policies can be “seamlessly” implemented and investors’ rights protected.

The key points of the Securities Transaction Tax amendment are threefold: 1) extend the tax‑exempt period for corporate bonds, financial bonds and passive bond ETFs by ten years to Dec 31, 2125; 2) include active bond ETF beneficiary certificates in the exemption from Jan 1, 2027 to Dec 31, 2125; and 3) delete the rules limiting the investment targets of passive bond ETFs, returning that authority to the relevant supervisory agencies to give the market more flexible development space.

items.title: 〈房產〉台北車站區商四土地釋出 預計11/16開標
items.title_en: Real Estate: Taipei Main Station Area Commercial Land Released, Bidding Expected on Nov 16
paras: 商仲業者第一太平戴維斯受託辦理台北車站精華商業土地公開標售，標的坐落於台北市中正區重慶南路一段，距離站前地下街Z10出入口僅300公尺，基地面積106.78坪，地上建物面積320.11坪，土地使用分區為第四種商業區，法定建蔽率及容積率分別為75%及800%，開標日為11月16日。
第一太平戴維斯指出，此一地產標售案具有產權單一、基地方正等優勢；而地產業者估計此一標售金額將逾10億元。

近年在危老重建政策推動及西區門戶計畫帶動下，台北車站商圈內具開發潛力的土地資產備受市場關注。根據內政部統計，台北市自2024年至今年8月累計核准危老案件達156件，主要集中於大安區、士林區及中正區等開發較早的區域。其中，北車商圈近三年已核准5件危老案，基地面積介於70- 400坪，集中在重慶南路一段及南陽街一帶。其中已有2件已取得建照，基地規模分別為72坪及152坪，目前均規劃為精品住宅產品，坪數約12-27坪、1至3房格局，預售成交單價約每坪140萬元。
台北車站商圈為台北市發展成熟的商業核心區，區內老舊建物比例較高，可開發土地稀缺，新案開發多仰賴危老重建機制推進。根據統計，2024-2026年間，北車商圈透天交易件數達12件，交易總金額為50億元，交易熱區主要集中於南陽街、信陽街及博愛路一帶。
而最新交易為今年6月博愛路一棟三層樓透天以8億元成交，土地面積約81坪，拆算土地單價約976萬元，由建商司取得。另外，也有資產公司陸續購入北車商圈7棟透天，計畫重建開發，總金額達11.9億元，合計取得土地面積約243坪，並將其中數棟透天申請危老重建，已於2026年8月申請建照，也反映開發商或資產公司持續關注北車開發機會。
第一太平戴維斯總經理陳逸鴻表示，隨著西區門戶計畫多項重大建設陸續到位，台北車站商圈正迎來新一波發展契機。預計於2027年完工的台北雙星C1棟、海悅國際商業大樓等指標開發案，將持續為北車商圈注入商業、辦公及觀光機能，不僅有助於提升整體商圈的動能，也可望帶動周邊商業活動與人流成長，進一步強化台北車站商圈作為首都門戶與核心商業區的地位，外溢效應亦可望帶動周邊都更及危老重建開發持續推進。
此一公開標售案坐落於北車商圈核心地段，臨20米重慶南路一段，基地面積106.78坪，地上透天建物面積320.11坪，土地使用分區為第四種商業區，法定容積率高達800%。此一標倍案產權單一且基地方整，百坪土地具備可立即開發條件，在北車地區相當稀有，未來可透過危老重建規劃精品住宅、商旅、及辦公空間等產品。
paras_en: First Taiwan-based brokerage Colliers International (First Tai Ping Davis) has been entrusted to handle a public auction of prime commercial land in the Taipei Main Station area. The parcel is located on Section 1 of Chongqing South Road in Zhongzheng District, only 300 meters from the Z10 entrance of the underground station mall. The site covers 106.78 ping of land with a building of 320.11 ping above ground. It is zoned as a Type‑4 commercial district, with statutory building coverage and floor‑area ratios of 75% and 800% respectively. The opening bid is scheduled for November 16.
Colliers notes that the sale benefits from a single ownership structure and a well‑located site, and estimates that the winning bid could exceed NT$1 billion.

In recent years, driven by the unsafe‑building renewal policy and the West District Gateway project, land assets with development potential in the Taipei Main Station commercial zone have attracted strong market interest. According to the Ministry of the Interior, Taipei City approved 156 unsafe‑building cases from 2024 through August of this year, mainly in the early‑development districts of Da’an, Shilin and Zhongzheng. Within the North Station area, five unsafe‑building cases have been approved over the past three years, on sites ranging from 70 to 400 ping, concentrated around Section 1 of Chongqing South Road and Nanyang Street. Two of these have already obtained building permits; the parcels are 72 ping and 152 ping and are being planned as boutique residential units of about 12‑27 ping, 1‑3 bedroom layouts, with pre‑sale prices around NT$1.4 million per ping.

The Taipei Main Station commercial zone is a mature core business district in the city, characterized by a high proportion of aging buildings and scarce developable land, making new projects heavily reliant on the unsafe‑building renewal mechanism. Statistics show that between 2024 and 2026, there were 12 townhouse transactions in the North Station area, totaling NT$5 billion, with hot spots centered on Nanyang Street, Xinyang Street and Bo’ai Road.

The latest transaction was a three‑story townhouse on Bo’ai Road sold in June for NT$800 million; the land area is about 81 ping, giving a land price of roughly NT$9.76 million per ping, acquired by developer Si. Additionally, an asset firm has been buying seven townhouses in the North Station area for redevelopment, spending a total of NT$1.19 billion for about 243 ping of land. Several of these properties have applied for unsafe‑building renewal permits, with building permits filed in August 2026, indicating continued interest from developers and asset managers in the North Station development opportunities.

Colliers General Manager Chen Yi‑hong said that with the rollout of several major projects under the West District Gateway plan, the Taipei Main Station commercial zone is entering a new wave of development. Flagship projects slated for completion in 2027, such as the Taipei Twin Stars C1 tower and the Haiyue International Commercial Building, will inject commercial, office and tourism functions into the area, boosting overall momentum, attracting more business activity and foot traffic, and reinforcing the station’s role as the capital’s gateway and core business district. The spill‑over effects are also expected to spur surrounding urban renewal and unsafe‑building redevelopment.

This public auction is located in the heart of the North Station zone, adjacent to the 20‑meter Section 1 of Chongqing South Road. The site covers 106.78 ping of land with a 320.11‑ping townhouse above ground, zoned as a Type‑4 commercial district with a floor‑area ratio of up to 800%. The parcel has a single ownership and a well‑aligned site; a hundred‑ping lot ready for immediate development is rare in the North Station area and could be used for boutique residential, hotel‑type, or office projects through unsafe‑building renewal planning.

items.title: 崇越深化日本布局 福岡營業所今正式啟用
items.title_en: Chongyue Deepens Japan Footprint as Fukuoka Office Officially Opens
paras: 半導體材料通路大廠崇越(5434-TW)持續加速海外市場布局，今(1)日宣布旗下日本子公司「峻川商事株式會社」於今日正式啟用福岡營業所，連同現有的東京總公司與熊本營業所，峻川商事在日布局第三個據點，藉由福岡得天獨厚的地理優勢與產業聚集效應，強化九州半導體重鎮的即時技術支援與新業務開拓動能。
福岡市作為九州第一大都會區與經濟樞紐，坐擁完善的海、陸、空交通網絡。崇越首席執行長陳德懿表示，過去崇越科技在九州以熊本為支點扎根在地服務；如今是一個好時機設立福岡營業所，藉由密集的航線與新幹線路網，往南可便捷通往長崎的影像感測器聚落、往北串聯廣島的先進記憶體重鎮，能更迅速應對新廠擴建商機與客戶需求，滿足晶圓代工新廠與IDM大廠在先進材料、設備與高階部品上的多樣化需求。
未來，崇越科技與峻川商事將持續評估日本據點擴展計畫，藉由供應鏈與價值鏈平台，將更多優質產品帶給客戶。
paras_en: Semiconductor materials distributor Chongyue (5434‑TW) continues to accelerate its overseas market expansion, announcing today that its Japanese subsidiary Junkawa Trading Co., Ltd. has officially opened a Fukuoka office. Together with its existing Tokyo headquarters and Kumamoto office, Junkawa now has a third location in Japan, leveraging Fukuoka’s unique geographic advantage and industry clustering to strengthen real‑time technical support and new‑business development in the semiconductor hub of Kyushu.

Fukuoka City, the largest metropolitan area and economic hub of Kyushu, boasts a comprehensive sea, land, and air transportation network. Chongyue CEO Chen De‑yi noted that the company has historically rooted its Kyushu operations in Kumamoto, but now is a good time to establish a Fukuoka office. With dense flight routes and Shinkansen lines, the location offers convenient southward access to the imaging‑sensor cluster in Nagasaki and northward linkage to Hiroshima’s advanced memory hub, enabling faster response to new plant expansion opportunities and customer needs, and meeting the diverse demands of wafer‑foundry new plants and IDM giants for advanced materials, equipment, and high‑end components.
Going forward, Chongyue and Junkawa will continue to evaluate plans to expand their Japanese sites, using supply‑chain and value‑chain platforms to bring more high‑quality products to customers.

items.title_en: Jia Da (2033) Doubles Again with Limit-Up Surge! What Is the Market Watching? Expanding into Semiconductor Cleaning—Will Orders Follow?
paras:

(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

本業動能放緩，無研發團隊成最大技術斷層
從本業基本面觀察，佳大主營鋼絞線與鋼線鋼纜，主要供應公共工程與基礎建設。2025年營收達7.03億元，年增21.65%，純益率為4.03%；但進入2026年後動能開始降溫，前8月累計合併營收為4.48億元，年減5.05%。在面臨低價進口品競爭與內銷成長瓶頸下，跨足高毛利半導體服務業確實屬合理的營運策略調整，但技術門檻的落差極大。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
根據公司年報顯示，佳大過去「並未成立專責研發部門，因此無研發費用支出」。半導體清洗製程涉及高純度化學品、超純水系統、潔淨室控制與專利材料等高階技術，與傳統鋼線抽線、酸洗等製程完全不同。佳大欲透過私募資金「買技術、買設備」，等於從零開始建立能力。
此外，半導體產業對於供應鏈稽核與產品認證非常嚴格，從送樣、客戶驗證、小量試產到正式放量，認證週期通常以「季」甚至「年」為單位計算。佳大目前僅完成資金與廠房到位，尚無任何客戶驗證或實質訂單揭露，短期內清洗業務要為營收帶來實質貢獻的難度相當高。

本益比破百倍，投資人後續三大觀察重點
根據《優分析產業資料庫》資料，目前的估值結構已高度反應市場對轉型的樂觀期待。對於關注佳大後續走勢的投資人，建議聚焦—驗證進度，廠房改建完成後的設備進駐時程，以及是否順利通過首家半導體客戶的廠區稽核與產品送樣。以及，本業訂單止穩狀況，第四季傳統鋼鐵旺季來臨後，公共工程與鋼絞線接單能否擺脫前8月衰退陰霾。

paras_en: Cold-rolled wire manufacturer Jia Da (2033-TW) rode the strong September rally in the steel sector, soaring nearly double in a single month. Beyond the rebound in steel prices and inventory reduction, market attention is focused on its announcement of a new business blueprint to move from traditional steel wire rope into "semiconductor cleaning".

Jia Da has been active lately, first completing a private placement of NT$518 million in August 2026, and in September using NT$405 million to acquire a 1,725.74‑ping land parcel and 2,320.96‑ping factory in Tainan’s Annan District, slated for conversion into a semiconductor cleaning division targeting front‑end wafer fabs, back‑end assembly and test, and memory makers.
Private‑placement price heavily discounted: about 39,000 private‑placement shares were issued at NT$13.185 per share, a steep discount compared with the recent market high.

Share capital expands about 36%, diluting earnings: Assuming Jia Da’s Q2 2026 capital injection of roughly NT$1.069 billion, the 39,000 private‑placement shares would increase total share count by about 36.5%. Using the 2025 EPS estimate of NT$0.35, EPS would be diluted to around NT$0.26 if the new business does not immediately contribute profit.
(Source: You Analysis Industry Database)

Core business momentum slows, and the lack of an R&D team creates a major technology gap. From a fundamentals view, Jia Da’s main business is steel wire rope and cables, primarily supplying public works and infrastructure. Revenue reached NT$703 million in 2025, up 21.65% YoY, with a net margin of 4.03%; however, momentum cooled in 2026, with cumulative consolidated revenue of NT$448 million for the first eight months, down 5.05% YoY. Facing competition from low‑priced imports and a domestic growth ceiling, moving into the high‑margin semiconductor services sector is a reasonable strategic shift, but the technological hurdle is substantial.
(Source: You Analysis Industry Database)

According to the company’s annual report, Jia Da has never established a dedicated R&D department and therefore has no R&D expense. Semiconductor cleaning processes involve high‑purity chemicals, ultra‑pure water systems, clean‑room controls, and patented materials—technologies entirely different from traditional steel wire drawing and acid‑pickling. Jia Da intends to use private‑placement funds to "buy technology, buy equipment," essentially building capability from scratch.

Moreover, the semiconductor industry imposes very strict supply‑chain audits and product certifications. From sample submission, customer verification, small‑batch trial production to full‑scale launch, certification cycles typically span quarters or even years. Jia Da has so far only secured funding and the factory; no customer verification or concrete orders have been disclosed, making short‑term revenue contribution from cleaning services highly challenging.

PE ratio exceeds 100×; three key follow‑up points for investors. According to the You Analysis Industry Database, the current valuation already reflects strong market optimism about the transformation. Investors watching Jia Da should focus on verification progress, the timeline for equipment installation after the plant conversion, and whether the company can pass the first semiconductor customer’s site audit and sample testing. Also watch the stability of core‑business orders—whether the traditional steel season in Q4 can lift public‑works and steel‑rope orders enough to offset the early‑year decline.
